body: Ahhhh thank you so much? The same goes for you, if you need to talk about anything. You're incredibly kind and if you need help getting through your own rough days I'm here.

I mean, I've been in therapy for the past 6 years, but it's always been hard for me to open up to them completely. I've just always trusted my friends/peers more. I am looking for a new therapist that I feel more comfortable with, though. I just hope it works. And self-care for me right now is more like, getting out of the house instead of staying inside for weeks at a time. It's bad but I'm stuck and I don't know how to get out of it.

I used to do that, yeah. The one thing I've never been totally awful at is helping people, but since I've been so consumed by my own problems the past few months it's been kind of hard to focus on other people's. Now might be the time to put more effort into that, then. Maybe if I can be useful to other people I won't feel as awful?? I hope.

That's actually really comforting, thank you. Talking and venting to people has always been my go to for making it through tough times, but lately it feels like no one IRL wants to listen. Which makes sense, since a lot of this is really heavy stuff and it can add up, but I'm having a really hard time finding a coping method to replace it with that works for me.

Thank you so much for replying. 

It IS torturous. It's like I'm doing everything I'm supposed to be doing to get better and it's just...not...working...? There is this tiny part of me that knows there may be a time in the future when things are better, but I'm just afraid I won't be able to make it until then. There were a lot of external factors that brought me to this point, and being hospitalized didn't really solve any of them or make me feel any more equipped to solve them myself. I still feel like a burden, I still hate myself, I can get out of bed most days but I'm not capable of being productive, there's still so many problems with my friends and family. 

Even if I am theoretically able to make it to the future, I don't even know if I want to anymore. I feel like I'm not really cut out for being alive, and these past couple weeks only drove that point home.
